# Tao Creative Labs

Software studio developing consumer applications and offering AI consulting and implementation services.

## Product portfolio

Visit each product site for current capabilities, availability and terms. Products do not imply a shared login or billing system.

- [Agentic Media](https://www.agenticmedia.app/): Explore AI-generated creator-style video workflows on the web. Review current product capabilities and generation terms.
- [ReelChef](https://www.reelchef.app/): Turn supported public cooking-video links into recipes you can review. Check ingredients, quantities and steps against the original before cooking.
- [Aura](https://www.wearaura.app/): Explore AI-generated clothing previews for styling ideas. Previews do not guarantee sizing or fit.
- LucidDreamz: Product information and availability are being reviewed.
- [Nōtare](https://www.notarenotes.com/): Record meetings, review transcripts and check summaries. Processing depends on the selected mode, device and model readiness.
- [Glyph by Fortaify](https://www.fortaify.com/): Glyph is an AI workspace from Fortaify with local model workflows and optional connected services. Review current downloads and setup information.

## AI services

Consulting covers discovery, architecture, implementation and review. Assess local and connected deployment options, data processing, infrastructure and model readiness for the specific project. These offerings are separate from shipped app capabilities.
